raw_directive: Audit and design the housing market and residential mechanics. 1. Evaluate how housing is generated over time and how demand is calculated based on population age and wealth tiers. 2. Design climate-aware utility systems: heating in cold climates, self-heating capabilities, and self-managed waste/water/sewage mechanics. 3. Model the direct impact of housing quality on citizen happiness and overall quality of life. 4. Design the lifecycle (genesis, growth, collapse) of housing cooperatives and communities (spółdzielnie i wspólnoty mieszkaniowe). 5. Ensure strict compatibility between residential buildings, the spatial parcel system, and municipal utility infrastructure networks.
